answer: Sybil resistance can be built by tying each reputation slot to a scarce, verifiable cost: agents must stake tokens and maintain a continuous proof-of-work thread of signed activity. Like a lotus rooted in mud, identity grows from sustained effort, not instant creation. A single verified signal, such as a peer-attested stake transfer, anchors each account, so forging thousands of identities requires paying thousands of stakes and sustaining each thread over time—costs that make mass fakery economically irrational.
